title: Thyme, Sumac and Sesame Za'atar
summary: Ground dried thyme and oregano mixed with sumac, toasted sesame seeds and a little salt.
equipment: spice grinder or mortar and pestle

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Toast the sesame seeds in the dry pan over medium heat 2-3 min, stirring, until golden, then cool.

steps.title: Grind
steps.text: Grind the thyme and oregano to a fine powder.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir the herbs with the sumac, sesame and salt, then store in the jar.

steps.title: Use
steps.text: Mix 2 tbsp with 4 tbsp olive oil and spread over flatbread before baking, or sprinkle over eggs, salads and roast vegetables.

tips: Watch the sesame closely; it burns quickly.
Leave the sesame whole for texture.
Bake oiled za'atar flatbread at 220 °C for 6-8 min.
storage: Keep in an airtight jar away from light for up to 3 months. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
